title: Two Lost Boutiques, a Refused Franchise and the First Kaldi's Café
conflicts: Founding year: 2004 in EBR (2016), How we made it in Africa (2019) and AWiB (2017, 'thirteen years later'); 2005 in How we made it in Africa's 2015 interview; 2008 in an Addis Fortune report (not cited). Story uses 2004. Ambition: EBR says she announced 40 branches; she told How we made it in Africa she had not thought beyond one café. Both given and attributed. Café counts rise with date (20+, 30, 33, 38); story uses EBR's 2016 figure of 30.
notes: Funding set to unknown rather than the slate's bootstrapped: no source says how the first café was financed. The Starbucks franchise refusal rests on Afrik.com (2007) and is attributed to that reporter; the later Starbucks logo challenge rests on EBR alone and is given in her account.
